Dear Madam,
The Daisy Chain cot in which I am specially interested is in the [Belgravian Children’s Hospital](/organisation/17) 1 Cumberland Street Belgrave Square[^1] Anything addressed to [Miss Munro](/person/2272) - at this direction, for the inmates will be gratefully accepted The [Children’s Hospital at Great Ormond Street](/organisation/3) has two [Aunt Judy](/periodical/54) cots which seem to be always well supplied
With many thanks

yours truly

C M Yonge
A little girl from this place was for two months at the Belgravian Hospital and was extremely happy


[^1]: An appeal for a Daisy Chain cot to be founded at Cumberland Street Children’s Hospital appeared in MP (1 January 1871) 92-5.
